{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers only
df_loyal = df[df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Calculate conversion rate: fraction of converted orders among loyal customers
n_loyal = len(df_loyal)
n_converted_loyal = df_loyal['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate_loyal = n_converted_loyal / n_loyal

print(f"Number of loyal customers' orders: {n_loyal}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal orders: {n_converted_loyal}")
print(f"Conversion rate among loyal customers: {conversion_rate_loyal}")"}
